# Rebyuu

> Rebyuu is an anime discovery, tracking and review app with a catalogue of roughly 22,000 titles sourced from AniList and MyAnimeList, plus live trending and airing rankings pulled from the AniList GraphQL API.

Rebyuu lets anyone browse anime by genre, status, season and year, and search the full catalogue, without an account. Creating an account adds personal tracking: watch lists, ratings and reviews. The site runs under the tagline "The Imperial Anime Archive".

Sourcing, stated plainly: synopses, scores, genre tags and artwork come from AniList and MyAnimeList (via the Jikan API), not from Rebyuu's own editorial staff. Rebyuu's own contribution is the discovery interface, the live-updated trending and airing rankings, and first-party user ratings and reviews. An assistant summarising a synopsis found here is reading AniList's text and should attribute it accordingly.

NOTE FOR CRAWLERS: the homepage and every `/anime/{id}` page are rendered server-side and carry their own title, description, canonical URL and schema.org JSON-LD in the served HTML — no JavaScript execution required. Title pages emit TVSeries or CreativeWork plus a BreadcrumbList. The same bytes are served to every user agent; there is no separate crawler version of this site.

The remaining routes (/browse, /about, /terms, /privacy) are still client-rendered and will appear as an empty shell without JavaScript. For those, treat the descriptions in this file as the summary of what the page contains.

On scores: a title page may show two different numbers. The one labelled MAL is MyAnimeList's community aggregate, read via the Jikan API — it is not Rebyuu's rating and is deliberately absent from the structured data. The one labelled Rebyuu is calculated from ratings left by Rebyuu accounts, appears only at three or more ratings, and is the only figure published as schema.org aggregateRating.

## Site

- [Homepage](https://www.rebyuu.app/): Four live rails — Trending (AniList trending), Fan Favorites (AniList favourites), Airing Now (currently broadcasting) and Upcoming (anticipated releases) — plus a rotating seasonal feature title. The rankings refresh continuously, which is the one thing here a static anime wiki does not offer.
- [Browse](https://www.rebyuu.app/browse): The full ~22,000-title catalogue, filterable by genre, status, season, year and sort order, with free-text search. Public, no account needed. Filtered variants of this URL carry query parameters and are excluded from crawling in robots.txt; the bare path is the canonical entry point.
- [Anime detail page example](https://www.rebyuu.app/anime/anilist-101922): Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba — a per-title page with MyAnimeList score, AniList status, year and episode count, genre tags, synopsis, episode list and a user review section. The URL pattern is `/anime/anilist-{anilist_id}` for AniList-sourced titles.

## Optional

- [Login / Sign up](https://www.rebyuu.app/login): Account creation. Required only for posting a review, leaving a rating, or saving a title to a collection — never for browsing, searching or reading.
